alert_news.title: Bihar Became India's First State with Silt Management Policy 2026
bullets: Bihar is the first Indian state to introduce a comprehensive silt management policy, named Bihar Water Source Restoration and Silt Management Policy 2026.
Policy, in partnership with NHAI under the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways, aims to manage river silt, improve flood control, and repurpose silt as filling material for national highways.

alert_news.title: Gold itna paas tha kaise jaane deti, says India's first woman wrestling world champion
bullets: Manisha Bhanwala became India's first woman wrestling world champion, winning gold in the 59kg freestyle category at the World Championships in Astana, Kazakhstan.
Her victory marks the first Indian woman to secure a world title in wrestling, a historic milestone for Indian sports.

alert_news.title: India's First Wushu Medal at Youth Olympics Won by Rajkumari
bullets: Rajkumari Lanchenbi Chanu earned India's first wushu medal at the Youth Olympic Games 2026, winning bronze in women's changquan combined.
First time wushu was a medal sport at the Youth Olympics.
Event held in Dakar, Senegal, marking India's third medal at the Games.

alert_news.title: India's First Hydrogen-Powered Train Operates on Jind‑Sonipat Section
bullets: India’s first indigenous hydrogen‑powered train, inaugurated 17 July 2026, runs on the Jind‑Sonipat section of Northern Railway.
Developed by Indian Railways and RDSO, it uses a Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cell and is supported by a dedicated hydrogen storage and refuelling facility at Jind, Haryana.

alert_news.title: Phase 2 of India's First Digital Census to Begin on Jan 10
bullets: India’s first fully digital population count (Census 2026) Phase 2 starts 10 Jan 2026, with a 15‑day self‑enumeration portal
Conducted by Ministry of Home Affairs; 40 detailed questions covering education, health, employment, caste

alert_news.title: India’s first Metro railway launched in Kolkata
bullets: Kolkata Metro, India’s first metro railway, opened 24 Oct 1984 on a 3.4‑km stretch between Esplanade and Bhowanipore
First underground railway in India; became a separate zone of Indian Railways in 2010

alert_news.title: KSLTA becomes India's first state tennis body to adopt National Sports Governance Act, 2025
bullets: Karnataka State Lawn Tennis Association (KSLTA) is the first state tennis association in India to adopt the National Sports Governance Act, 2025.
The adoption was made by unanimous resolution at an Extraordinary General Meeting held in Bengaluru.
The Act establishes a transparent, accountable governance framework for sports administration across the country.

alert_news.title: India’s First Indigenous Bullet Train Promises Speed, Comfort
bullets: India’s first indigenously designed high‑speed bullet train, 8‑coach B28, manufactured at BEML Bengaluru for the Mumbai‑Ahmedabad corridor.
Maximum test speed 280 km/h, operational speed 249 km/h, 202 m long, 557 passengers, 320 kW power output.

alert_news.title: India’s First Youth Olympic Swimming Medal
bullets: India’s first-ever swimming medal at the Youth Olympics, won by Dhinidhi Desinghu (bronze) in girls’ 100 m freestyle
Event held at 2026 Youth Olympic Games, Dakar; time 56.27 s, best Indian time

alert_news.title: India's first indigenous bullet train to carry 557 passengers at 249 kmph - o Heraldo
bullets: India’s first indigenous high‑speed bullet train is being manufactured at BEML Bengaluru for the Mumbai‑Ahmedabad corridor.
The 202‑metre, eight‑coach train will carry 557 passengers, reach a test speed of 280 kmph and operate at 249 kmph.

alert_news.title: Maharashtra to set up India's first Road Safety Training and Research Institute in Saswad: Sarnaik
bullets: Maharashtra will establish India’s first Road Safety Training and Research Institute at Saswad, Pune district.
The institute will feature an Automated Testing Station (ATS) and modern technology for road safety training and research.

alert_news.title: NTPC to set up India's first ceramic-based project to generate solar power at night in Rajasthan's Bhadla
bullets: India’s first ceramic‑based concentrated solar power (CSP) pilot, 320 kW, at Bhadla Solar Park, Rajasthan, using 247Solar’s high‑temperature ceramic modules.
Stores solar heat during the day and generates electricity at night via an air turbine, reducing reliance on battery storage.
Approved by Rajasthan Renewable Energy Corporation Limited (RRECL) and operated by NTPC for internal consumption.

alert_news.title: India's First Bullet Train Takes Shape: Railway Minister Reviews Manufacturing Progress
bullets: India’s first Bharat‑made bullet train B28, manufactured at ADITYA facility Bengaluru, reviewed by Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw on 1 Nov 2026.
Production uses precision‑engineered jigs, Squeeze Test for structural integrity, and integrates HVAC, couplers, and advanced onboard systems.
Train is part of the Mumbai‑Ahmedabad high‑speed rail corridor, marking the first indigenous high‑speed rail vehicle in India.

alert_news.title: Assam to Set Up India's First Public-Sector Proton Therapy Centre
bullets: India’s first public‑sector proton therapy centre to be established at Gauhati Medical College and Hospital, Guwahati, Assam under the Assam State Secondary Healthcare Initiative (ASSIST).
Project cost ₹600 crore, financed by a ₹315 crore World Bank loan and a ₹285 crore contribution from the Assam government.
Expected to become operational within three years, making it the third proton‑beam facility in India after private centres in Mumbai and Chennai.

alert_news.title: India's First Bullet Train B28: Speed, Features, Capacity and Specifications
bullets: India’s first indigenous bullet train, B28, built by BEML at its Aditya Plant in Bengaluru for the Mumbai‑Ahmedabad High‑Speed Rail corridor.
Eight‑coach train, 202 m long, capacity 557 passengers, operational speed 249 km/h (tested up to 280 km/h).
Features 25 kV AC traction, regenerative braking, Wi‑Fi infotainment, and accessibility provisions for Divyangjan passengers.
